title: Johnston Island scuttlebutt: Soviet orbital nuke shot down, object recovered
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Johnston Island scuttlebutt: Soviet orbital nuke shot down, object recovered, about 1962-1963 at Johnston Atoll (Bluegill, 1962), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: First of all something had fallen down toward the island from that explosion in the sky. The explosion lit up the entire South Pacific and and caused all sorts of alarm and reports of UFOs and so on. And something had been recovered.

related.note: Same Johnston Island event, with something falling from the blast and being recovered. Here the object is explained as a Soviet orbital nuke that was shot down, not a UFO.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels passes on what he heard from a man named Bob Jacobs about Johnston Island, a small atoll in the Pacific, in 1962 and 1963. According to the story, an explosion high in the sky lit up the whole South Pacific, set off alarm and UFO reports, and something fell toward the island and was recovered, with talk that a Soviet nuclear weapon in orbit had been shot down. If true, it would mean an unknown object was quietly picked up after the blast.
